rows: 2026-11-25 — Three fresh iOS 27 hosts measured the expanded learner suites. The slowest cumulative ten LeetCode cases took 596.5 s and eleven took 651.3 s. Twelve Tamil cases took 549.8 s and thirteen took 627.8 s on that host. Qualify ten and twelve respectively, preserving later candidates for explicit selection. A focused case-selection test and an Android process-relaunch flow passed. Direct Tamil keyboard submission passed on the local iPhone in 9.7 s.
